span.p: INTRO — You start with the 4 borrowed garments (crown, hauberk, cloak, buckled shoes). Time door destination: 1583.
WIN — supervisor walks in at 9:30am to restored timeline
2026 — get a loaf of pan de barra from the cafeteria
2026 — give the hourglass to the baker → she lends you the oven gloves
2026 — get a slice of pizza from the time door room
Examine the cloak → notice the 'WR' embroidery
1583 — talk to the Queen about the cloak → 'oh, that's Wally's cloak' — she gives you a bottle of brandy
1583 — talk to Raleigh in the Tower cell
1583 — get a codpiece from the chest of Raleigh's belongings outside his cell
1583 — get the hourglass from the chest of Raleigh's belongings outside his cell
1583 — meet Raleigh outside as he gives the leopard-skin to the Queen -> return cloak and get the denim jacket
1583 — give Raleigh the leopard-skin and tell him about the secret door → he slides out on the skin
1666 — use pizza slice on Pepys -> he falls off rollerskates and hurts his leg
1666 — give Pepys the ruler -> he limps off to bed (unlocks the bedroom)
1666 — give Pepys brandy -> he falls asleep
1666 — return buckled shoes -> get the roller skates
1666 — get the bed warmer from the bedroom
1666 — get Pepys's wig from garden pond
1666 — get the wine and cheese out of the garden ditch
1078 — get the architect's long ruler
122 — give Hadrian the bed warmer in the teddy-bear oven gloves
122 — get the leopard-skin from throne
122 — return crown -> get the pink beanie
1078 — give the architect bread + cheese + wine -> he goes for lunch break
1078 — amend the Tower design: secret door from Raleigh's cell to outside via helter-skelter slide
1078 — return the hauberk, give codpiece + wig → get the dress
